lines.text: In visions of God, the LORD set Ezekiel on a very high mountain, where a man like bronze stood in the gateway.
The man held a linen cord and a measuring rod, and he measured the wall as one rod thick and one rod high.
The man climbed the steps of the gate facing west and measured it, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees.
He led Ezekiel into the inner court through the south gate, where the burnt offering was washed in a chamber.
The north-facing chamber was for the priests in charge of the altar, the sons of Levi, the only ones who could approach the LORD.
